description: This Swift source file defines an enum NodeDisplayName with static methods and properties to handle device display names based on device type and interface idiom. It provides utility functions to resolve display names, check for generic names, and normalize device names.

methods.name: isGeneric
methods.description: Checks if the given device name is one of the predefined generic names.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default display name for a given interface idiom (phone or pad).

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Determines the appropriate display name based on existing name, device name, and interface idiom.

methods.name: normalizedDeviceName
methods.description: Checks if the device name contains keywords indicating iPhone, iPad, or iOS, and returns a normalized name if so.
